cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.
